title: President Trump Holds Press Gaggle Before Flight to Kalispell, Montana Rally - 10/14/26
summary: Trump press gaggle before a Montana rally: inflation at 1.7% for three months, inherited the worst inflation in US history, the Iran war is ending so energy prices will fall fast, and oil is lower than under Biden.

assertions.quote: we're at 1.7% inflation for the last three months
We inherited a terrible inflation from Biden, the worst in the history of our country.
Iran will end very shortly. It's going to be over very shortly. And your energy prices will fall very rapidly, very fast.

verdicts.note: A prediction; a quick fall depends on Gulf shipping reopening and refined-product supply recovering.

assertions.quote: Oil was higher under Biden than it is under Trump.

verdicts.note: WTI near $80 in October 2026 is below the 2022 peak near $100 but about level with the 2021-24 average of roughly $78.

WTI averaged 97.31 in Sep 2026 (latest month), 22% above the Biden-period (Feb 2021-Jan 2025) mean of 79.74 and 15% below the Biden peak of 114.84 (Jun 2022); only 5 of the 48 Biden months (Mar-Jul 2022) were higher than Sep 2026, so oil is dearer than under the typical Biden-era month.
